COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_deliver_engineering_renewal = {
if = { limit = { original_tag = ENG has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_project_engineering_renewal NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_delivered_engineering_renewal } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_delivered_engineering_renewal clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_project_engineering_renewal if = { limit = { any_owned_state = { is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT is_on_continent = europe free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no } } } random_owned_state = { limit = { is_fully_controlled_by = ROOT is_core_of = ROOT is_on_continent = europe free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no } } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1  add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_delivered_engineering_renewal_success } else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_engineering_renewal_paid } set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_engineering_renewal_paid } modify_treasury_effect = yes } else = { set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 4 }

            limit = { country_exists = IRE has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_ireland_refused NOT = { has_war_with = IRE } }
            if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_union_mode = 2 } }
                create_wargoal = { type = puppet_wargoal_focus target = IRE }
                clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_devolved_irish_settlement_resolved
            }
            else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_union_mode = 1 } NOT = { has_cosmetic_tag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_ENGLAND } }
                create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = IRE }
            }
            set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_ireland_wargoal_issued
        }
hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_refresh = yes }
}

}

COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_initialize_congress_clock = {

set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_day = 0 }
set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_gap = 0 }
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_1_answered } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_day = 0 } }

else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_3_answered } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_day = 42 } }
else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_4_answered } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_day = 63 } }
else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_5_answered } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_day = 84 } }
else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_6_answered } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_day = 98 } }
else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_7_answered } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_congress_day = 112 } }
clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_1_open
clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_1_presented
clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_2_open
clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_report_2_presented
